title: Chapter 262
text:
No pop-up window, free to read!

The intelligence included the location of all the nuclear warheads of the Germinal Organization. If he dismantled these nuclear warheads, the Germinal Organization's Hand of Death system would be useless.

When he stole the intelligence from the Germinal Organization headquarters, he wanted to hand it over to the Six Nations. The sooner the Germinal Organization was destroyed, the sooner his Grade A main mission [Dust of the Sleeping Seeds] could be completed. His current progress was 36.2 percent. Handing over this intelligence would deepen his role in the war to destroy the Germinal Organization.

The only intelligence he kept was the class advancement knowledge. Han Xiao was planning to sell this to the players to make a fortune. He was very familiar with controlling the source to monopolize the market.

The representatives of the Six Nations stood up excitedly.

"It's all top secret!"

"With this intelligence, we can end this war early!"

"Well done!"

This intelligence would bring unimaginable benefits to the Six Nations. It was like two people playing cards. If one could see through the other's hand, the advantage would be obvious. The outcome of the war would change with this piece of intelligence.

And the initiator of all this was Han Xiao, who was sitting at the end of the conference table, digging his ears.

The representatives of the various nations looked at each other, and the atmosphere became silent.

Han Xiao was very understanding and said, "Okay, I've given you the intelligence. It's up to you what you want to do. I'll leave first."

He got up and left. After pushing open the door, he suddenly stopped and turned around. Seeing that everyone was indifferent, he could not help but say in disappointment, "Is there really no ambush …?"

The representatives' mouths twitched.

Ambush? How strong are you? Don't you have any idea?

We still want to live until we retire, bastard!

Gu Hui wiped the cold sweat off his forehead. "Your intelligence is very important. You've helped us a lot. We need to have an emergency meeting … so you should leave quickly."

…

The situation of the expedition war changed drastically in just a few days. The troops of the Six Nations advanced by leaps and bounds as if they were on steroids. They defeated the enemy again and again like the autumn wind sweeping away the fallen leaves, obtaining great victories. In the four battlefields of the East, South, West, and North, the Germinal Organization was at a disadvantage.

The entire world was paying attention to the battle and was shocked by the sudden change. After many inquiries, they found out that it was Han Xiao who had leaked the stolen information to the Six Nations.

When Han Xiao's true identity was exposed some time ago, he was surrounded and became the focus of the battle between the Germinal Organization and the Six Nations. Han Xiao was in the middle of the encirclement, and it was like he was in the eye of the wind, surrounded by an even stronger wind. The battles on the various fronts had reached a climax, and a large number of the Germinal Organization's troops were being held back by the Six Nations. That was why they did not have enough troops, and the long-range bombing missiles launched into the sky were all intercepted by the Six Nations.

At that time, the various forces had a premonition that if Han Xiao could escape, it would change the entire situation.

As expected, he became the turning point of the entire war!

He was the one who started the war in the dark, and the one who was going to end the war was also him. All the powers were astonished.

He deserved the title of a legend!

Because they had the upper hand in the war, the Six Nations also started to broadcast the situation of the war in their own countries to reassure the people and announce that the war was about to end. The people of the various countries all felt relieved, and the pressure on their countries was also relieved. Of course, the media could not avoid adding details to the Germinal Organization's deeds. Although the Germinal Organization was already bad enough, they still habitually added to it, emphasizing that the expedition was absolutely righteous, politically correct, and protecting the country.

The Blue Star players were even more aware of the changes in the war, and the most direct feeling was that there were fewer missions.

Originally, with Han Xiao's help, the conflict between the Six Nations and the Germinal Organization had broken out earlier, so the players' influence on the storyline would be minimized. At least the players had something to do, but the war suddenly went smoothly. Now, even being a spectator had become a luxury, and the players were completely reduced to spectators.

The Germinal Organization players were an exception. Their missions had increased, and at the same time, their experience of failing missions had increased.

According to the increase ratio of the number of missions to the number of failures, they seemed to have suffered a loss.

The players from both sides fought a lot. The Six Nations players were gloating on the forums, and the Germinal Organization players were crying but had no tears.

Why! Black Phantom wants to hurt us again and again?
